    The open penny-farthing with n = 2 ([mild] MIPF) #

    Penny-farthing data with v = ρ ρ, w = a₁ β (points x₀, x₁ = t). An exit is an arrow from x₀ or x₁ to a point off the penny-farthing, an entry an arrow from such a point into x₀ or x₁.

    • not_exit_entry_a: an exit ε at x₀ and an entry δ at x₁ with δ ≫ β ≠ 0 do not coexist ([mild] figure 4.3, first diagram).
